playstyle: An oddball bear built on ranged poking and whiff punishment, sharing Kuma's moveset. Use her massive range and damage to punish every mistake, and go into Hunting Bear Stance (HBS) and her roll and sit stances for odd mix-ups. Her huge, wonky hurtbox makes her take bigger combos, so avoid getting launched.

stances.name: Hunting Bear Stance
stances.entry: D or 3+4 after moves like db+2 and u+1+2
stances.note: HBS.3+4 is a power crush and Heat Engager; HBS.df+2 and HBS.1+2 tornado; HBS.d+1+2 launches on counter hit.

stances.name: Roll
stances.note: ROL.1 is +4 on block and guard-breaks in Heat. Heat enhances the roll stance (Wavu).
